value.rationale: Polygon quadrangulations are an intrinsic Fuss–Catalan family. The first Fourier singularity at eight sides, its exact 72-dimensional blind space, characterization of the 16 minimal cancelling pair characters by crossing diagonals, sharp unrestricted projection amplification 59/16, and immediate zero-free return at ten sides answer natural invertibility and stability questions not settled by unsigned counts alone. The M8 cut-graph interpretation makes the finite census structurally relevant; no paper-scale or infinite-family generalization is needed. Exact binary Fourier recoverability is useful as a canonical worked boundary case.
